topic: What beam allocation strategies optimize spectrum efficiency in hybrid satellite-WiMAX networks during peak demand?
response:
{
    "response": "Optimizing spectrum efficiency in hybrid satellite-WiMAX networks during peak demand requires dynamic beam allocation strategies that prioritize beams based on user density and traffic demands. This can be achieved through techniques like time division multiplex (TDM) or dynamic spectrum access, allocating resources to beams with higher user loads.  These strategies aim to minimize inter-cell interference while maximizing spectral efficiency."
